context:
Training Gym R69 completed! ALL 4 PASS ON FIRST TRY! Crossed 95% perfect milestone!

R69 RESULTS (all 10/10):
1. trie-001 (T7) - TrieNode with children dict + is_end. Insert/search/starts_with all O(m) where m=word length.
2. sparse-table-001 (T9) - Precompute st[k][i] = min(arr[i..i+2^k-1]). O(1) RMQ: k=floor(log2), min(st[k][l], st[k][r-2^k+1]).
3. sliding-window-001 (T7) - Monotonic deque: remove out-of-window from front, remove smaller from back. Front = max.
4. dp-coin-change-001 (T7) - Min coins: dp[i]=min(dp[i-c]+1). Ways: process coins outer loop, dp[i]+=dp[i-c] (avoids permutations).

DB: 293 exercises, 515 attempts, avg 9.9, 95.0% perfect. 244 passed. Tier 9+ = 63.
35+ consecutive rounds all 10/10.
decisions: Trie: node.children = dict, node.is_end = bool. Insert: traverse/create nodes, mark end. Search: traverse + check is_end.
Sparse Table: st[k][i] = min(arr[i..i+2^k-1]). Build O(n log n). Query O(1): k=floor(log2(r-l+1)), min(st[k][l], st[k][r-2^k+1]).
Sliding window max: monotonic deque of indices. Remove out-of-window from front, smaller values from back. Front always = max.
Coin change ways: outer loop = coins (not amounts!) to avoid counting permutations. dp[i] += dp[i-c].
